source.title: Individual animal liveweight and daily liveweight gain, and pasture herbage mass recorded in a dairy x beef grazing study comparing contrasting grazing methods: set-stocked versus cell-grazed on a temperate permanent pasture, 2018–2025
source.attribution: Rothamsted Research. Individual animal liveweight and daily liveweight gain, and pasture herbage mass recorded in a dairy x beef grazing study comparing contrasting grazing methods: set-stocked versus cell-grazed on a temperate permanent pasture, 2018–2025. DOI: 10.23637/rothamsted.00033688. CC BY 4.0.

limits: The repository page currently supersedes an older dataset version and reports minor corrections plus additional data through 2025.
The collated CSV contains cohort numbers 1–4 grouped into two-year cohorts; preserve each cohort intact for evaluation.
The dataset describes the same six North Wyke plots across cohorts. Holding out cohort 4 tests later cohorts on those plots, not new-farm generalization.
DLWG is computed from start/end liveweight and elapsed days; it is not an independent measurement from those endpoints.
Treatment has three plot replicates per arm. Animal-period rows are repeated observations, not independent treatment replicates.
This dataset does not contain USDA CPER grazing-bout/velocity measures, individual dry-matter intake, feed costs, or a confinement arm; it cannot validate the current engine.js.
